_comment: API CONTRACT v1 - what Person 1's app calls on Person 3's server. Base URL in dev: http://<person3-laptop-ip>:8000

GET /animal/{animal_id}.purpose: profile + eligibility after the app scans an ear tag

error_404.detail: animal not found in BPA records

POST /session.purpose: upload one scoring session (photos + video + metadata), get the scored result back

fields.device_session_id: app-generated unique id, used to prevent duplicates on retry

POST /session.response_on_retry: same object with extra field duplicate:true - the app treats it as success and marks the queued session synced

error_404.detail: animal not found in BPA records

error_422.detail: animal not eligible: not in first lactation (currently lactation 2)

error_413.detail: side file too large - max 10 MB. Use a smaller photo / record a shorter clip (~8 s).
error_413._note: caps: photos 10 MB each, video 25 MB, whole request 50 MB - compress/re-encode before upload and show the detail string to the user on 413

GET /session/{session_id}.purpose: full stored scorecard for one past session (for 'open old session' screens and the demo console)
GET /session/{session_id}.response: the stored session document: session_id, animal_id, date, weight_kg_mid, health_flags, result (full scoring_result object). Internal fields (_id, file paths) are stripped

GET /demo.purpose: judge-facing scoring console web page: run sessions, browse scorecards with overlay proof, weight trends, vet officer alert feed - a complete demo without the mobile app

POST /sync.purpose: reconcile the offline queue: app asks which queued sessions the server already has
POST /sync.rule: exists -> app marks it synced locally; missing -> app re-uploads it via POST /session (which is retry-safe and returns duplicate:true if it actually arrived)

POST /chat.purpose: farmer chatbot: ask about ONE animal, answered ONLY from its record + care advice. Devanagari question -> Hindi answer, otherwise English

request.language: auto | en | hi | kn - forces the reply language (optional, default auto = follow the question's script)
request.speak: true -> response also carries audio_url with a spoken reply (optional, default false)

response.answer: Your Gir's weight is around 398 kg (from the 2026-08-12 session). The trend is upward.
response.model: which brain answered: 'gemini:<model>' or 'groq:<model>' (cloud free-tier chain, rotating keys), 'ollama:<model>' (local, offline), or 'template' (instant deterministic record answer - same facts, canned phrasing)
sources: traits.md - Rump Angle  (which reference-corpus sections grounded the answer; empty for pure record answers - the app can show these as 'from official guidelines')
response.disclaimer: shown under every answer in the app

POST /chat.rule: if escalate is true the app shows the urgent-vet banner prominently; emergency keywords in any supported language trigger it

error_404.detail: animal not found in BPA records

POST /transcribe.purpose: speech-to-text ONLY - the app puts the text in the chat box for the farmer to review/correct before sending (preferred UX). STT chain: Gemini (rotating keys, strong Hindi/Kannada) -> local whisper

fields.language: optional hint en/hi/kn (from the app's language selector) - steers both STT engines, prevents Hindi being mis-heard as English

response.heard: मेरी गाय का वज़न कितना है?

error_422.detail: could not hear any words - please record again closer to the phone

POST /chat/voice.purpose: spoken version of /chat: farmer records a question, server transcribes locally (whisper), answers with the same grounding rules, and returns a spoken reply WAV when a matching voice exists
POST /chat/voice.response: same object as POST /chat plus: heard (the transcribed question) and audio_url (path to the reply WAV, or null - the app MUST handle null by showing text only)

error_422.detail: could not understand the audio - please record again closer to the phone

GET /voice-audio/{fname}.purpose: fetch the spoken reply WAV referenced by audio_url

GET /animals.purpose: roster for the app's animal picker and demo UIs

GET /chat-ui.purpose: self-contained professional chat web page (text + voice) served by the backend - works offline, useful for demos and as a reference client

GET /alerts.purpose: vet officer's notification feed - escalated screenings (high risk or herd outbreak signal), newest first

GET /overlays/{session_id}/{trait_name}..purpose: the explainability image for one trait (photo with keypoints + measurement drawn)
